integrity: The universal conclusions follow from analytic arguments; rational tests are corroborative. Literature comparison is scoped to inspected sources and does not establish absolute priority.
limitations: Exact truncated real polynomial map only, odd d≥3 and negative original coefficient. No transfer to the full secant algorithm or generic perturbations; no explicit stable-manifold graph or uniform cone-entry bound.
title: Global escape and recurrence rigidity in the odd negative secant model
